shortcut_name: Three-material certificate is exactly a triangle
evidence: deepseek: "if adj[a][b] ... if adj[a][c] and adj[b][c]"; qwen3-coder: "Check if this forms a triangle (all three pairs are connected)"; gpt-oss: "common = a_adj & adj[b]"
affordance_in_statement: A minimal certificate consists of exactly three materials such that no matter how they are divided between the two available units, at least two materials placed in the same unit will be volatile together.
removal_suggestion: There is no wording-only removal: for exactly three materials and two units, the stated condition is mathematically equivalent to all three volatile pairs being present, i.e. a triangle. Avoiding this shortcut requires changing the core certificate condition or its size/partition model, which would change the task.

survivor_shortcuts.affordance: A certificate consists of exactly three materials whose pairwise volatility forces a conflict under two-way division.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Use bitset intersection to find a common neighbor of every volatile pair, which is a triangle.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: A certificate consists of exactly three materials such that no matter how they are divided between the two available units, at least two materials placed in the same unit will be volatile together.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Enumerate all 3-combinations and test whether all three pairs are edges.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: A minimal certificate consists of exactly three materials.

common_affordance: The two-unit impossibility condition for exactly three materials is equivalent to finding a triangle (three pairwise volatile materials).

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It prints the first triangle encountered while iterating through input edges, rather than the lexicographically smallest triangle; input edge order is not tied to lexicographic order.

recommended_edit: No valid edit can defeat all survivors while preserving the immutable format, bounds, examples, and the stated three-material/two-unit certificate task. Any effective edit must change the core certificate definition or partition model so that the condition is no longer exactly triangle detection.
